symptom: A lost live completion update leaves a cloud turn without its recorded changes because the renderer cannot prove that the mirror's unstamped final summary is newer than the worker opening.
rule: Advance each changed worker summary's timestamp, preserve that authority through replay and imports, and accept a newer stamp against the creation time of a legacy opening. See git show 7b6eb9e6:agents/zstack/changes/turn-changes-disclosure.md.
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/src/renderer/features/agent/__tests__/cloud-transcript-hydrate.test.ts -t 'worker.*final diff through the mirror'
